paragraphs.text: Composer dock monitor for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): Context brick matrix, per-turn net upload/download
Tokens, and 200ms native macOS CPU, GPU, and MEM bar charts.
# System & Session Monitor
Five pills in the DeepSeek Harness composer dock. Context, tokens, and live system readings share on
e row. Click any pill to open its card.
English · 中文
## The five pills
| Pill | Live reading | Card |
| Context | 5x3 micro grid and usage percentage | 20x5 brick matrix, system prompt / tool defs / mes

sages split, cache hit rate |
| Tokens | Net upload and download per turn | Direction arrows, up/dow

n ratio, up to 16 step bars, cache hit rate |
| CPU | User plus system load, with a 36 s bar chart |

60 s bar chart with peak line, user and system detail, top 5 processes |
| GPU | Device utilization
, with a 36 s bar chart | 60 s bar chart with peak line, renderer and tiler detail, top 5 processes

|
| MEM | Used and total, with a 36 s bar chart | 60 s bar chart with peak line, wired / compressed
/ floor rows, top 5 processes |
Drag any pill to reorder. The order persists in localStorage.
## Cards
One card opens at a time. Click anywhere outside to dismiss.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or install the release tarball:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Link a local checkout while developing:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DeepSeek Harness afterward.
Requires macOS and clang (Xcode Command Line Tools). On first start the plugin compiles `sampler.c`
into `bin/sampler`. When the install directory is read-only it builds into the system temp directory
/sampler`. When the install directory is read-only it builds into the system temp directory instead.
## Sampling
| Item | Value |

| Rate | One frame every 200 ms |
| CPU | Per-core tick deltas, split into user and system |
| GPU |

IOAccelerator PerformanceStatistics |
| Memory | vm_statistics64, same basis as `top` PhysMem |
| T

ransport | NDJSON stream from the host |
| Idle stop | Sampler exits 5 s after the last subscriber l

eaves |
| Orphan guard | Sampler exits when the parent process is gone |
## Fallbacks
| Condition | Behavior |
| clang missing | Frames built from `top`, `ioreg`, and `sysctl` once per second, LOW tag on the pil

l |
| Not macOS | Native sampler off, falls back to CPU and memory from node:os |
| Process query fa
ils | Card shows a placeholder, metrics keep updating |
## Slots
The plugin takes three entries in the composer dock. It replaces the built-in usage and activity ind
icators with its own five pills.
